input: Scheduled ventures prompt (prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md brief): continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products
task: Flagship 4 (changepoint-detector), item 2: a pre-registered BBQ round on a composite of NBER's monthly coincident indicators

doc_friction.issue: Plain `route` with no --task drew research for a scheduled run whose stored prompt is the ventures brief; prompt.md says to pass --task, which is easy to miss on a scheduled run.

deviations.why: The pre-registered script crashed before any output on a blank CE16OV month (2025-10, shutdown). Added a one-blank-month fill, committed separately before the first scored run, disclosed in the script header and README.
deviations.result: only arm B reads CE16OV; arm A (which ships) is unaffected

deviations.why: cite_check could not reach doi.org/crossref/openalex for Harding and Pagan (2002); the DOI was dropped and the reference kept as author, title, journal, volume and pages rather than leave an unverified identifier.

goal: Reproduce NBER's monthly turning points with a published rule on public data, and ship the method if it passes the pre-registered bars
notes: Result: arm A (PAYEMS, W875RX1, INDPRO, CMRMTSPL composite, Conference Board method, bigMove 0.05) 16/16 NBER turns within 3 months, 0 false, F1 1.000 vs random 0.271; components alone 10-14. Arm B (+CE16OV) 15/16. Ships --turns in cli.mjs (turns-cli.mjs, composite-index.mjs). Framed as reproducing Harding-Pagan with today's vintages, not new. Data via raw.githubusercontent.com copies of FRED downloads (FRED refused the proxy), cross-checked against independent copies (data/SOURCE.md).
